item.media:description: Brock Purdy and the San Francisco 49ers lost for the first time this season on Sunday, but are still the favorites to win the Super Bowl.

item.title: Colts trade G Quenton Nelson to Seahawks for 2027, 2028 draft picks
item.description: Nelson, the No. 6 pick in 2018, is an eight-time Pro Bowler and six-time All-Pro.
item.media:description: Quenton Nelson has made the Pro Bowl in every season since being drafted by the Colts in 2018.
